title: Build the change stream: named heartbeat, watchdog, visible stale state, reload on reconnect
statement: Watch the content root and deliver change hints. Emit a NAMED heartbeat event carrying data at a fixed interval. Run a client watchdog that renders a visibly stale state — by text or icon, not colour alone — when a heartbeat does not arrive within its window. Reload on reconnection. A watcher failure emits a visible signal or closes the stream.
notes: ⚠️ A comment-line keepalive is ignored by the client parser (AST-0036) — it keeps the socket warm and leaves the page looking healthy. The heartbeat must be an event a listener can fire on. ⚠️ No event buffer, event id or `Last-Event-ID`: events are hints and never deltas, so a reconnecting client that reloads is exactly caught up. ⚠️ Logging a watcher failure to the server console is explicitly not enough. The operator is looking at a browser.
